boilerplate: General risk factor section reorganization and expansion of boilerplate language (restructured risk categories from individual topics to grouped headings)
sector_wide: Developments with respect to low-carbon fuel policies and the market for alternative fuels may affect demand for renewable fuels and could adversely affect financial performance
Pandemic/public health risks affecting demand for transportation fuels (inferred from 50% expansion of risk factor section during COVID year, sector-wide impact on refining margins)
Increased ESG and climate-related regulatory risk disclosure (new TCFD, SASB reporting framework risks)
company_specific: Joint venture investment risk - DGD expansion with nearly $2B additional capital commitment decreases ability to manage risk
Feedstock supply disruption risk expanded to include rendered and recycled materials reflecting material growth in renewable diesel operations
Ethanol plant reduction from 14 to 13 plants indicating operational restructuring/asset rationalization

escalated_risks.risk: Refining margin volatility - escalated from normal cycle risk to severe demand destruction during COVID-19 pandemic year (FY2020)
Feedstock supply and pricing risk - expanded scope to include renewable feedstocks (rendered materials, recycled oils) reflecting larger and more complex supply chain
Environmental and climate regulatory compliance risk - significantly escalated disclosure from 1 to 21 ESG/climate mentions, indicating heightened regulatory scrutiny

resolved_risks: Rail car transportation cost risk - prior filing specifically referenced 'additional costs as a result of our use of rail cars for the transportation of crude oil'; this specific risk factor title is not cross-referenced in current filing
VLP segment integration risk - merger transaction with VLP completed and fully integrated into refining segment, no longer referenced as ongoing risk
